title: The Hobart Branch Library: The Ghost Stories the Library Tells Itself

sources.what: ONE SOURCE for the ghost stories (Scoop OK'd a single source, Nov. 10, 2026). Staff accounts at the Hobart Branch: 'back in the '90s after re-painting the workroom' staff found 'a strange green slime covering the walls'; a janitor quit after hearing a voice tell her to 'get out!'; books found 'on the floor or placed where they shouldn't be' the next day; before opening, a staff member saw 'a white-haired woman wearing a black dress and clunky old-fashioned shoes walking up one of the ramps', followed, and she was gone; the branch head at the time, locking up at the Main Street door, 'spotted a woman in a floor-length white dress' and left quickly; 'The rumor is that a woman was murdered in the house, which was then sold directly to the library, but there are no official reports of a murder in the newspapers of the time'; 'LCPL now has a policy against staff working alone in our buildings, simply for safety's sake'; no sightings since
sources.who: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: Get out. A janitor at the Hobart Branch library in Indiana said a voice told her that. She quit.
beats.label: HOBART, INDIANA
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: The library tells these stories itself. In the 1990s, after the workroom was repainted, staff found green slime covering the walls.
beats.label: LAKE COUNTY PUBLIC LIBRARY, HOBART BRANCH
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: Before opening, a staff member saw a white-haired woman in a black dress walking up a ramp. The staffer went after her. She was gone.
beats.label: BEFORE OPENING
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: A branch head, locking up, looked back, and saw a woman in a floor-length white dress. He left quickly.
beats.label: THE MAIN STREET DOOR
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: Rumor says a woman was murdered in a house later sold to the library. But the library says there are no official reports of a murder in newspapers of the time.
beats.label: THE RUMOR
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: Today, the library system doesn't let staff work alone, for safety's sake. It says there have been no sightings since.
beats.label: TODAY
beats.credit: Lake County Public Library, 'The Hobart Branch Haunting'

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.
